crossRefs.note: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it…
When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck…
for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was…
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…

translations.web: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
